notes.title: Cosmic Monsters 2 >Enclaves Dawn
notes.notes:
tells the story of 16 year old Francis who starts his training at the OSA (Orasis Security Agency).

Accompany Francis on his journey through Orasis and help him to thwart the dark machinations of the enclave that want to suppress the region and recreate it according to their imagination.

I also fight 9 medals from the region and then prove myself in the regional league of the Orasis region.

 

Cosmic Monsters> Enklaves Dawn <is a single player 2D RPG game based on a popular Monster RPG franchise. The game is to be published on the PC and then also on Android smartphones.

In addition, the game should not contain any microtransactions, which means = once bought and done.

100% no Pay to Win, as I personally consider the game manufacturer's policy to be questionable to offer content in the game for sale in order to gain progress.

Cosmic Monsters> Enclaves Dawn <should be released on Steam this year.

notes.title: CM Update 2.4
notes.notes:
There was a small bugfix regarding game crashes.

In the "Mountain Range" map, the screen froze after the Enclave Rüpel was within sight, since the script that executed the command had to wait until the path was clear.
This has now been fixed, the script now recognizes whether the path is blocked and now skips the part.
The attacks damage values of "double attack" and "triple attack" were reduced.

changes:

-> Fixed a crash in the "Mountain Range" region
-> Damage reduction for "double attack" and "triple attack"

A big thank you to my players who pointed this out!

greetings

~ Marco
